Hi Alex — thanks for sharing the questionnaire. I started filling the technical tabs and wanted to address your specific questions below (high-level; we can add contractual language as needed):

1) Deletion SLA (live stores, logs, backups)
- Live data (customer indexes/objects): deletion API processes requests in real-time; objects removed from primary stores typically within seconds–minutes depending on workload. We offer a contractual deletion SLA of 48 hours for enterprise customers (can tighten for specific agreements).
- Logs: application and access logs are retained by default for 90 days. We can configure log retention windows down to 7 days for strict compliance customers. Note: shortening logs can impact forensic capabilities.
- Backups: backups are retained by default for 180 days. Backup deletion is a separate controlled process — we can include a contractual clause to ensure backups containing the deleted data are purged within 30 days of a deletion request for enterprise agreements. Typical RTO/RPO trade-offs apply.

2) Audit log retention and option to shorten — yes, configurable with a minimum of 7 days. We log user-level and admin actions and provide exportable, signed logs for audits on request.

3) Backup encryption keys
- By default, backups are encrypted using Redwood-managed keys (AES-256).
- We support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for both live data and backups for enterprise/private deployments — this is available for Dedicated and Private customers and can be enabled at provisioning time.

I’ve attached the partial questionnaire with technical answers in the "Infrastructure" tab. I can finish the remaining rows if you point me to the specific control IDs you care about.

Attachments: Vendor-Security-Questionnaire-Amaya.xlsx

If it helps, Neha — happy to join a short technical call with Alex/Jordan to go through the questions live.
